name: tome
prompt: A giant ancient magical book, closed, standing upright: thick dark brown leather cover with ornate raised gold filigree, gold corner guards and clasps, a round gold emblem in the centre of the cover, glowing gold edges on the pages, fantasy relic.

name: lanternpost
prompt: A tall carved dark wooden boardwalk post, square with carved panels and a capital, topped by a black iron hexagonal lantern with warm glowing amber glass, a little moss at the base, fantasy swamp town style.

name: railing
prompt: One straight section of a carved dark wooden boardwalk railing about three metres long: two carved square posts at the ends, a thick top rail, a bottom rail and carved turned balusters between them, weathered wood with a little moss, front view.

name: crystals
prompt: A cluster of large glowing teal-cyan crystals growing out of a dark mossy rock, sharp hexagonal crystal points of different heights, luminous turquoise glow inside the crystals, fantasy swamp.

name: island
prompt: A floating rock island: a chunk of earth and rock with an inverted cone shape underneath, hanging roots and vines dangling from the bottom, a gnarled bonsai-like tree with a lush green canopy on top, moss and ferns, a small waterfall spilling over one edge, fantasy.

name: bonsai
prompt: A gnarled bonsai-like swamp tree growing on a small mossy rock islet: twisted thick trunk, exposed roots gripping the rock, a flat layered lush green canopy, hanging moss, fantasy.

name: lily
prompt: A cluster of three giant round Victoria water lily pads with upturned rims, deep green with red-veined edges, one pink water lily flower in bloom, floating flat, viewed from above at an angle.

name: door
prompt: A grand arched double front door of dark heavy carved wood with black iron straps, ring handles and studs, set in a carved wooden arched frame with a keystone, two small lanterns on either side, front view, fantasy tavern.

name: signframe
prompt: An ornate carved gold baroque sign frame with scrollwork, leaves and a crest on top, a wide rectangular empty dark panel in the middle with no text at all, front view, flat.

name: balcony
prompt: A straight section of a rustic dark wooden balcony railing about four metres long, carved balusters, thick handrail, with green vines and moss hanging down over it and a few small leaves, front view.

name: mossclump
prompt: A hanging clump of grey-green Spanish moss strands draped over a short horizontal branch, long wispy strands hanging down, isolated.

name: cliff
prompt: A tall jagged floating rock cliff island with a waterfall pouring off the top edge, mossy ledges, a few bonsai trees on top, hanging roots below, fantasy landscape piece.
